en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad Al Ashary and Muhammad Bin Yahya, altogether from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Sa’dan Bin Muslim, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [7:180]
And Allah's are the Best Names, therefore call on Him by these.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘We<sup>asws</sup>, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, are ‘الْأَسْماءُ الْحُسْنى’ the good names which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will not be Accepting the deeds from the servants except (if they are) with our<sup>asws</sup> recognition’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash‘ari and Muhammad ibn Yahya altogether have narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Su‘dan ibn Muslim from Mu‘awiya ibn ‘Ammar from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following about the words of Allah. “
God has the most blessed Names. You should address Him in your worship by these Names . .” [7:180]
The Imam said, “We, I swear by Allah, are the most blessed names of Allah without which Allah does not accept any of the good deeds of His servants until they know us properly.”
